channel.title: The Chatham Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Chatham Daily News (chathamdailynews.ca)

item.title: Local roundup: All-Stars stay on ballot; Barnstormers sign slugger; Josling eighth
item.description: The Chatham Coloured All-Stars stay on the Canadian Baseball Hall of Fame ballot for the veterans committee "forever or until they are inducted," operations director Scott Crawford says.

item.title: Provincial Junior Hockey League regular season enters final week
item.description: Teams are still jockeying for playoff positions as the PJHL Stobbs Division starts its final week of the regular season.

item.title: Boris Genov loves Chatham Maroons' winning atmosphere
item.description: Boris Genov enjoyed being a fan during the Chatham Maroons’ Sutherland Cup run last season.

item.title: LKSSAA girls volleyball playoffs begin this week
item.description: The LKSSAA girls volleyball playoffs get underway Tuesday with the AAA semifinals.

item.title: Accused killer of Milton woman has died in custody, Chatham court hears
item.description: Sky-Linn Holden, 25, was to appear Tuesday by video, but court heard she had died at Windsor's South West Detention Centre.

item.title: Musical comedy coming to St. Andrew’s
item.description: Four performances of the long-standing comedy, I Love You, You’re Perfect, Now Change: The Musical, will be coming to St. Andrew’s.

item.title: Renoviction motion passed, report and draft bylaw to come
item.description: With a large crowd in the chamber, a Chatham councillor's motion aimed at stemming renovictions took the next step Monday night.

item.title: Pain Court swimmers win multiple LKSSAA races
item.description: Pain Court’s Gavin Schinkelshoek won three events while teammates Harrison Walsh, Jack Harrigan and Xavier Caron each won two at the LKSSAA swim meet.
